note: Stage 1 recognition set. English utterances are synthesised locally by Kokoro so the harness runs unattended; they measure the transcription path, NOT human speech. Telugu and mixed entries must be recorded in your own voice: record a mono WAV named <id>.wav into tests/speech/recordings/ and the harness will pick it up automatically.
